labels.description: Applies to the alpha release line

issues.title: Camera framing during fast vertical or horizontal room transitions
issues.body: When players move quickly through vertical or horizontal stage sections, camera panning can occasionally lag behind the leading player. Further smoothing and bounding improvements are planned.

issues.title: Specialized vehicle/mini-game second player handling
issues.body: Certain specialized transformation mini-games (e.g. horse wagon sequences) are originally designed around a single player focus. Further co-op parity refinements will be added in upcoming builds.
